title: Experiment integration calendar and OKR matrix for progressive model rollouts
creator: Sofia Mendes
description: Create a single, cross-functional experiment calendar that maps major progressive model rollouts to team OKRs, compliance windows, and operational milestones. The calendar should reduce ad-hoc coordination by providing a canonical timeline for evaluation horizons, traffic ramps, and rollback checkpoints across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Deliverables: OKR-aligned matrix, calendar with frozen timelines for audits, and a lightweight decision playbook that product, engineering, reliability, and security can sign off on.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical experiment calendar published and approved by PM, Eng, and Security
OKR matrix links each experiment milestone to at most one objective and one measurable key result
All rollouts have explicit evaluation windows, dominant metric, and a defined rollback threshold
Hand-off checklist exists for Dedicated and Private customers with compliance notes
milestones: 2025-06-20: Draft OKR matrix for Q3 experiments completed
2025-07-09: Final calendar published and Slack announcement
2025-07-15: Playbook and runbook templates added to Confluence
2025-08-01: First experiment aligned to matrix begins ramping traffic
metrics: Primary metric: net quality score (internal eval avg) delta >= +2% for promotion
Safety metric: regression burn-in <= 0.5% of traffic per 24h window
Latency: p95 tail within SLO for target deployment (hosted: <120ms, dedicated: <90ms)
Cost: incremental cost per 100k tokens within OKR budget bucket
OKR mapping: each KR must map to a measurable metric in the metrics list
rollout_gates: Gate 1 - Smoke (0.1% traffic, 6h): no P0 errors, no regressions >1%
Gate 2 - Golden Shard validation (1% traffic, 48h): automatic stress tests and KV-cache integrity checks pass
Gate 3 - Ramp (10%->50% over 72h): primary metric uplift and latency SLOs stable
Gate 4 - Commit (>=90% traffic): final sign-off by PM and SRE, compliance checklist completed
escalation_path: Step 1: On-call SRE notified via PagerDuty and #rollouts channel
Step 2: PM initiates mitigation plan and posts status doc with timeline
Step 3: If customer-facing degradation >30m, escalate to Head of Product and Head of SRE
Step 4: For compliance-impacting incidents, Security intercepts and pauses rollout immediately
instrumentation: Dashboard: experiment overview with p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, primary metric trend
Traffic shards: labeled by region, customer tier, and golden shard membership
Regression harness: nightly eval against held-out prompt set with quality debt budget reports
Alerting: automated alerts when primary metric drops by configured percentage or latency exceeds SLO
